subject: general
question: How many additional LPG connections will be provided under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana in the current financial year(2025-26) announced in September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The government will provide 25 lakh additional LPG connections under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana during the current financial year.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Modi made the announcement during Navratri, linking it to women’s empowerment and joy during the festival.**
 
• **The government will spend over ₹2,000 on each of the 25 lakh new LPG connections, expanding the reach of the Ujjwala scheme.**
 
• **With this expansion, the total number of Ujjwala beneficiaries will rise to 10.58 crore households.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)**__

 
 
• Launched in May 2016 to provide LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
 
• The scheme aims to ensure clean cooking fuel availability to reduce health risks from traditional fuels.
